parameters.content:
## Eval of the REAL Sales agent
No copy of the agent here. Each dataset row (sheet **eval**, 27 cases with expected values) is sent to the production webhook with test_run: the full pipeline runs (code checks, Haiku extraction, quote check, scoring in code), side effects are off (no Pipedrive, Telegram, drafts). The agent writes its result to the **Tests** sheet; this workflow reads it back and compares field by field.

Run: Evaluations tab → Run test. One row ≈ 15 s.
